sourceFile: 48. BRS-161014 Report test tracking process Main 1-Main 2_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source context but does not define a valid changed-factor comparison or cite result rows adequately.
issues: Changed factor is filename-derived, not evidence-derived.
Baseline and changed/test conditions are not explicit.
Outcome stats cite only the header, not the data rows.
Process-stage grouping is incomplete and may omit Main 1/result rows.
Aggregated sample counts are not traceable to cited rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the intended comparison Main 1 vs Main 2 process stages, or tracking all process steps?
Should this be treated as root-cause tracking rather than a changed-condition validation?
correctionPlan: Redefine changed factor from report evidence, e.g. process tracking stage/location if supported.
Use actual result rows as evidence for each process step and metric.
Preserve process/stage keys such as Main 1, Main 2, Sub 4 and operation name.
Separate or group outcomes by the same tracking context only after all rows are visible.
Remove unsupported aggregate statistics or recalculate with row-level citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are insufficient; header/title rows must be supplemented with cited result rows.
